Produced with Drone Studios, the Sky Show combines precision drone technology, custom aerial animations, and synchronized music to create an unforgettable Fourth of July experience over the Pacific.

The La Jolla Sky Show was created as a free community celebration and a quieter, environmentally conscious alternative to traditional fireworks. What began as an idea for bringing La Jolla together on Independence Day has grown into an annual tradition enjoyed by families, residents, and visitors from across San Diego and beyond.

Thank you to our sponsors, donors, community partners, volunteers, and everyone who came out to make the 2026 Sky Show possible.
